stem: There are 2.54 centimeters in 1 inch. Which of the following is closest to the number of inches in 40 centimeters?
steps: Set up the conversion so centimeters cancel: 40 cm × (1 in / 2.54 cm).
Trap: 101.6 comes from multiplying by 2.54. An inch is longer than a centimeter, so there must be fewer inches than centimeters.
key: Write units in the conversion factor so the unit you don't want cancels.
